analysis:
Both supplied units are base-side excerpts of CHANGELOG.md (lines 4067-4538), which is historical release-note prose. The only change in this file is near lines 11-39: a new v0.10.10 candidate entry describing waitlists for clusters and Darkbloom Sandbox (darkbloom waitlist, an approval gate on new sandbox setup and new pairs). The patch excerpt is truncated, and neither the waitlist code nor the coordinator side is supplied, so I could not verify enforcement.

No code, key handling, encryption, attestation, or authorization logic is changed in the examined text. The changelog does not alter the TB-011/TB-012/TB-013/TB-014 controls or T-041 cache behavior.

The base excerpt mentions App Attest, prefix cache and SSD behavior only as historical notes. These are consistent with the retained threat model and add no new attack surface.

Remaining integration questions for later passes, as unverified contracts rather than findings:
- The waitlist feature touches TB-013 (sandbox installer download and run as the Mac owner, T-061) and TB-014 (GPU limit, T-062). Code outside this batch should confirm that the approval gate is advisory UX/coordinator policy rather than a security control. It should also confirm that the 'existing setups never asked' and 'offline cluster local' paths do not skip installer integrity checks.
- The new `--yes` flag for sandbox setup must not bypass the owner confirmation in the TB-014 gpu-limit flow.
- Confirm that coordinator waitlist responses are treated as untrusted input.

The threat model may need a note on the waitlist network call from the CLI. That cannot be determined from the changelog alone.
